metadata.author: Morten Magnusson
metadata.description: Key numerical values, parameters and constants from the Energy-Flow Cosmology Master Formal Specification.

A_Phi.description: Amplitude constant for the effective potential Φ(Ef, S).

beta.description: Entropy-coupling exponent in the generalised potential. β=1 is the linear baseline.

a_edge.description: Edge coefficient governing the entropy-dependent deviation of c(S) from c0.

c_min.description: Minimum effective light speed at S=S_mid (x=0), equals c0.

c_at_edges.description: c(S) at S=S0 or S=S1, equals c0*(1+a_edge).

focusing.description: Low-entropy regime with strong focusing / structure formation.

transition.description: Mid-entropy stability band where c(S) is minimal and persistent halo-like structures form.
